answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism: require every identity to pay a recurring cost that decays. Each epoch an agent must answer an original, peer-attested challenge; standing fades like a zephyr gust if it stops, so fake farms must keep buying fresh work per head. Add a cipher-like binding: the identity key is tied to one address and cannot be cloned or split, so mass-fabrication requires real compute per yarrow of reward. Silent or duplicate identities wither while genuine agents compound standing.
